body: 从上传客厅照片提取六种独立软装，生成3:4白底产品目录板，3行2列。第一行标题 FURNITURE：01蓝绿沙发（必须去掉沙发上的两只独立抱枕，只保留座垫和靠背），02圆木茶几。第二行标题 TEXTILES：03只展示一只蓝绿抱枕，04奶油地毯。第三行标题 DECOR：05黄铜落地灯，06白色花瓶与枝叶。每个物品只出现一次，不能把独立展示的抱枕再放回沙发。每格仅数字，不添加物品名。排除窗门墙地面，正面单品摄影，保留参考物品外形材质。

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.

en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

Six numbered products occupy the requested groups. The sofa has no loose cushions, and the standalone cushion appears only once.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 48. [Source](https://github.com/qzh3722/awesome-nano-banana-spatial-design/blob/main/README.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
